title: Iran's IRGC rejects reports of communications with the US: ‘IRGC DOES NOT ENGAGE IN DIPLOMACY AT ALL’
text:
Iran's IRGC rejects reports of communications with the US: ‘IRGC DOES NOT ENGAGE IN DIPLOMACY AT ALL’"

"‘IRGC has never had, either now or at any other time, any official or unofficial communication with the United States’ — spokesman
